purpose: Concrete deployment bindings for the otherwise source/destination-agnostic projection and input-validation procedures.

expression_contract.argument: Resolve a declared invocation argument; missing required arguments fail before I/O.
expression_contract.value: Resolve a named prior operation result or caller-supplied derived value.
expression_contract.item: Resolve a field of the current iteration item.
expression_contract.concat: Concatenate evaluated strings; no evaluation of source code.
expression_contract.format_index: Format a supplied nonnegative integer as a decimal string padded to at least two digits.
expression_contract.path_guard: All repository output paths must pass the configured guard before use.

credential.storage: Never serialize a token into this configuration; workflow supplies its authorized credential.

push.scope: Existing workflow path filters remain authoritative; this file does not alter workflow triggers.

event_comment.normalization: Wrap returned current comment in a one-item collection; event payload body is not trusted as current.

scan_issue_comments.pagination: Fetch every page via the API pagination mechanism before ending the scan.

current_comment.reason: Re-fetch each candidate so an edited event or scan snapshot cannot supply a stale body.

repository_json.decode: Require file/base64; decode UTF-8 and parse JSON.
repository_json.not_found: Return absent; distinguish from authorization or network failures.

skip.reason: Do not consume controller replies as new agent submissions.

per_item.absent: Use the separately defined initial-state contract; never invent prior accepted progress.

per_item.when: A next agent-facing step is required by the separately defined state protocol.

iteration.recovery: Reuse persisted source identity, instruction, draw and reply records. Do not create a new source comment or reroll to recover a partial delivery.

output_arguments.target_index: Next index supplied by state protocol; not chosen by routing.
output_arguments.repository_path: Evaluated configured path for the selected output route.
output_arguments.record_value: Structured result supplied by diagnostics/state/instruction/publication logic.
output_arguments.existing_blob_sha: Current destination blob SHA, read before replacing a repository file.
output_arguments.rendered_body: Complete instruction/comment body supplied by renderer; routing does not author semantic text.
output_arguments.artifact_path: Exact explicitly authorized target path supplied by verified publication plan.
output_arguments.artifact_content: Full UTF-8 content supplied by verified publication plan.
output_arguments.summary_rows: Per-input acceptance/rejection/error report supplied by validation and persistence functions.

lookup_order: Use known_reply_id if present and verify its source linkage.
Otherwise paginate comments in configured issue and locate the existing controller record whose source_comment_id matches.
If no matching reply exists, create one in the configured issue.
controller_reply.history: Preserve source-linked controller history using the existing publication contract; no duplicate source-revision/target-index entry.

validation_report.current_behavior: Existing workflow reports malformed/rejected inputs in saved diagnostics and workflow warnings/summary; it does not currently publish a dedicated correction comment.

artifacts.sha_rule: Omit sha only for verified absent destination.
artifacts.guard: Only a completed verified publication plan may invoke; routing configuration does not authorize arbitrary artifact paths.
artifacts.required_readback: Read same branch/path and compare exact UTF-8 bytes and digest.

preconditions: Fetch existing destination from the same branch.
Require JSON object root for state/diagnostic/instruction/receipt records.
For immutable routes require exact equality if present, never overwrite a conflict.

verification.test: Decode and compare saved JSON to record_value.

paths: Repository-relative; no absolute path, empty segment, dot/dot-dot traversal, backslash or NUL.
Validate source ID and digest before interpolation.
Artifact paths must match the separately verified authorized target set.
guards.source_mutation: This deployment never rewrites the agent source comment while validating, rendering or routing results.

concurrency.mode: Serialize writes to the target branch; use blob SHA concurrency for replacement.

guards.failures: Expose missing arguments, failed reads, conflicts and failed readbacks. Do not relabel transport/persistence failure as invalid agent JSON.

integration_boundary: This document describes current concrete destinations and argument bindings for future consumption. Existing workflow remains unchanged and still has inline routing; no integration or end-to-end success is claimed.
